watches.name: MOUNT WEST "SUMMIT" - V1 - MEDIC (Limited)
watches.description: Honoring Those Who Heal The Summit - Medic is a limited edition tribute to the medical community - the practitioners, first responders, and healthcare professionals who dedicate their lives to healing others. Limited to ten units per production run. Giving Back to The Community 10% of the proceeds from each watch will be donated to a major medical organization of the communities choosing. Giving support to those who go above and beyond for the greater good of our society. Design Details Built on our acclaimed Snowfall dial foundation, the Medic edition features distinctive red hour markers replacing the standard black indices. This thoughtful design choice carries deep symbolism: red represents the life-saving work of medical professionals, the urgency of their calling, and the compassion that drives them. The brilliant white fully-lumed dial creates exceptional visibility in any condition - a practical necessity for those who work around the clock. Like all versions of the Summit, the Medic model features our proprietary Dual Uni-Directional bezel system - designed for tracking multiple time intervals simultaneously. Whether timing medication administration, monitoring patient vitals, tracking shift rotations, or managing decompression during recovery, the innovative dual bezel provides the precision medical professionals demand and an engagement with the watch never felt before.

watches.name: MOUNT WEST "SUMMIT" - V1 - ABYSS
watches.description: Mount West introduces its debut timepiece, featuring our proprietary "Dual Uni-Directional Bezel" technology-- bringing a new level of utility and engagement to the user. Designed, tested and serialized in the U.S., it houses a Swiss Sellita SW200 automatic movement, blending Swiss precision and American innovation. Inspired by the rugged landscape of the American Mountain West region, the case is a dance of polished and brushed surfaces, flowing into sharp and aggressive end links-- like traversing a desert plateau before stepping into steep mountain valleys. With its proprietary bezel, 200 meters of water resistance, a scratch-resistant domed sapphire crystal, a versatile adjustable clasp, and exceptional luminous detailing for low-light visibility-- This watch is a perfect balance of form and function. At the dial's center, a deep blue cascades outwards, gently fading into black. Like stars above the water, bright hour markers chart the path of time. This color is inspired by the unimaginable depths of what is above, below, and within us. SPECIFICATIONS Size: 39mm Case Thickness: 11.8mm Lug width: 20mm Lug-to-Lug: 44.3mm Water Resistance: 20 ATM / 200 Meteres / 660 FT. Movement: Swiss Sellita SW200 Dial Color: Blue w/ Date Display and Luminescent 24 Hour Inner Register Bezel: Dual Uni-Directional [Proprietary Technology] Crystal: Sapphire Case and Bracelet: Stainless Steel End Links: Solid Crown: Screw Down Caseback: Screw Down w/ North Star Chart Bracelet: 20mm to 18mm taper with screw pins Clasp: 1/2" Adjustable Warranty: 3 Years
